minor_factorization.coefficient_encoding: Each coefficient is an exact vector in the displayed basis; complex coefficients have separate real and imaginary vectors.
minor_factorization.matrix_definition: K[r,c]=(1/(4*sqrt(5))) sum_{a,b: r=c+a mod 4} T[a,b]*tau^(a*b)*i^(b*c), tau=-(1+i)/sqrt(2)
minor_factorization.normalization: The exceptional T[0,0]=sqrt(5) is divided by sqrt(5), so the zero Weyl overlap is a_0=1.
